instructions: Verified decision tree. Match the one leaf whose field conditions all hold, then return its label. Every declared input matches exactly one leaf.
If context=internal, action=approve, risk=FALSE, return deny.
If context=internal, action=approve, risk=TRUE, return deny.
If context=internal, action=approve, risk=UNKNOWN, role=admin, return allow.
If context=internal, action=approve, risk=UNKNOWN, role=analyst, return deny.
If context=internal, action=approve, risk=UNKNOWN, role=auditor, return allow.
If context=internal, action=change, risk=FALSE, role=admin, return uncertain.
If context=internal, action=change, risk=FALSE, role=analyst, return deny.
If context=internal, action=change, risk=FALSE, role=auditor, return uncertain.
If context=internal, action=change, risk=TRUE, return deny.
If context=internal, action=change, risk=UNKNOWN, role=admin, return allow.
If context=internal, action=change, risk=UNKNOWN, role=analyst, return deny.
If context=internal, action=change, risk=UNKNOWN, role=auditor, return allow.
If context=internal, action=export, return review.
If context=partner, action=approve, role=admin, return allow.
If context=partner, action=approve, role=analyst, return deny.
If context=partner, action=approve, role=auditor, risk=FALSE, return deny.
If context=partner, action=approve, role=auditor, risk=TRUE, return deny.
If context=partner, action=approve, role=auditor, risk=UNKNOWN, return allow.
If context=partner, action=change, role=admin, return allow.
If context=partner, action=change, role=analyst, return deny.
If context=partner, action=change, role=auditor, risk=FALSE, return deny.
If context=partner, action=change, role=auditor, risk=TRUE, return deny.
If context=partner, action=change, role=auditor, risk=UNKNOWN, return allow.
If context=partner, action=export, return review.
If context=sandbox, risk=FALSE, action=approve, return deny.
If context=sandbox, risk=FALSE, action=change, return review.
If context=sandbox, risk=FALSE, action=export, return review.
If context=sandbox, risk=TRUE, return review.
If context=sandbox, risk=UNKNOWN, return uncertain.

dsl.final_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    ((event.risk == TRUE) and (event.context == sandbox)) or (event.action == export)

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == sandbox)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.role == analyst) or ((event.context == internal) and (event.risk == FALSE))

rule CriticalRequiresReview:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = review

rule UnknownExternalUncertain:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRiskPrefersAllow:
    when ((not (Critical(event))) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))) and (event.risk == UNKNOWN)
    then prefer label = allow priority 90

rule TrustedApprovePrefersDeny:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == approve)
    then prefer label = deny priority 80

rule ActionChangeSandboxPrefersReview:
    when (event.action == change) and (event.context == sandbox)
    then prefer label = review priority 70

rule AdminPartnerPrefersAllow:
    when (event.role == admin) and (event.context == partner)
    then prefer label = allow priority 40

rule TrustedForbidsAllow:
    when Trusted(event)
    then forbid label = allow

rule OtherRolesPreferDeny:
    when (((not (Trusted(event))) and (event.role in {analyst, admin, auditor})) and (not (Critical(event)))) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))
    then prefer label = deny priority 1

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch1:
    when ((event.action == change) and (event.context == internal)) and (event.role == analyst)
    then require label = deny

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch2:
    when ((event.action == change) and (event.context == partner)) and (event.role == analyst)
    then require label = deny

    ((event.risk == TRUE) and (event.context == sandbox)) or (event.action == export)

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == sandbox)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.role == analyst) or ((event.context == internal) and (event.risk == FALSE))

rule CriticalRequiresReview:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = review

rule UnknownExternalUncertain:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRiskPrefersAllow:
    when ((not (Critical(event))) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))) and (event.risk == UNKNOWN)
    then prefer label = allow priority 90

rule TrustedApprovePrefersDeny:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == approve)
    then prefer label = deny priority 80

rule ActionChangeSandboxPrefersReview:
    when (event.action == change) and (event.context == sandbox)
    then prefer label = review priority 70

rule AdminPartnerPrefersAllow:
    when (event.role == admin) and (event.context == partner)
    then prefer label = allow priority 40

rule TrustedForbidsAllow:
    when Trusted(event)
    then forbid label = allow

rule OtherRolesPreferDeny:
    when (((not (Trusted(event))) and (event.role in {analyst, admin, auditor})) and (not (Critical(event)))) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))
    then prefer label = deny priority 1

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch1:

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch2:
